tests.name: a time on every Home row (105) > shows how long a Do now session has waited, from the event that asked, failed or went quiet
tests.why: session question, failure and stall wait time with hover text

tests.name: a time on every Home row (105) > counts a task in Do now from its last change of state, and a stopped one as a last change
tests.why: failed task and pass-to-merge task time

tests.name: a time on every Home row (105) > uses when a review was asked when the source says, and says when it does not
tests.why: review requested, with and without the request time

tests.name: a time on every Home row (105) > shows a Plan or background session's last change as a relative time, the later of its last event and its last update
tests.why: session in Plan or background shows a relative last change

tests.name: a time on every Home row (105) > shows an outside row's last change in Plan and the background, and nothing when its source gave no time
tests.why: work item and pull request rows

tests.name: Home's outside work (4) > gives a work item its last change, and a parent shown for context its own last change rather than its newest child's
tests.why: parent row uses its own time, not its child's

tests.name: a time on every Home row (105) > shows no time for a missing or unreadable date, or before the clock is read, and none in the future
tests.why: no made-up time when the date is missing

tests.name: Home's outside work (4) > gives each row the time its source says, and none where the source says nothing (105)
tests.why: source gives no time, so no time; review falls back to last change

tests.name: a time on every Home row (105) > uses when a review was asked when the source says, and says when it does not
tests.why: asserts the exact unknown-request hover text, in the body rather than the title

tests.name: Home's outside work (4) > puts the owner's draft in Plan from either source, keeps others' drafts out, and moves a draft on when it turns ready (106)
tests.why: Azure DevOps and GitHub drafts, someone else's draft, a draft turning ready

tests.name: Home's outside work (4) > orders the owner's own pull request as the dashboard does: draft, failed build, then reviewers' changes, never counting the author's own vote
tests.why: existing test changed: draft band moved from background to plan

tests.name: Home's bands > states each band's rule as the owner worded it (106)
tests.why: exact rule text of all three bands; help-text copies not covered

tests.name: a time on every Home row (105) > moves with the clock: the same row reads longer a minute later
tests.why: checks the tick only; order, focus and colour are not checked here

tests.name: Home's row times tick with the clock without moving rows or focus, and say on hover what they measure
tests.why: title quotes the MUST's tick-without-moving-rows-or-focus wording

tests.name: shows the owner's pull requests, reviews and work items from Azure DevOps and GitHub on Home, in the band each belongs to
tests.why: changed test asserts the row time draws no colour of its own

tests: tests/unit/wait-clock.test.ts::a passed task keeps the time it passed when its pull request is drafted and the draft is left
findings.note: Raised at a later head, against a test the fix round added (not on this map's head). It compares two separately sampled timestamps. This is a flaky test, not an unmet requirement, so a base-failing test would not expose it.

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::makes a chat into a task the owner reviews, which runs alone and waits on Home for a merge or a pull request preview
tests/unit/row-time.test.ts::a time on every Home row (105) > counts a task in Do now from its last change of state, and a stopped one as a last change
findings.note: The render matrix in the acceptance list was incomplete, and the browser task test never asserts the task row's time. The unit taskTime test covers the helper but not the renderer. A base-failing test would not expose this coverage gap.

notes: Test titles cite PLAN item numbers (105, 106), not MUST numbers, so none counts as strict on that basis. MUST 6's order, focus and colour checks are only in Playwright. MUST 5's help-text copies have no unit test. row-time.test.ts imports a new module, so on base it fails at import, not on an assertion.
